title: Democrat Mary Peltola closes in on victory in closely watched US Senate race in Alaska – live
summary_full: Challenger nears 50% of the ballot to secure victory in final midterms contestProtests greet Trump on Asia visit – follow liveSign up for US Breaking News emailAbdul El-Sayed, the Democratic-Senator elect from Michigan, said today that he would be happy to work with the Trump administration to pass one of his tentpole policy agenda items – Medicare For All.“Everybody’s like, ‘ah well, you’d work with Donald Trump to get Medicare For All?’. I’m like hell yeah, because the point for me is Medicare For All. I don’t care who puts their name on it. I need to go back and talk to Michiganders, and I need to know that our service made their lives easier,” he said at the Atlantic Summit in Washington DC. Continue reading...
